description: Official Badlands workshop example 'mountain' (badlands-workshop examples/mountain, commit 1bfad47): 50 Myr of uplift from data/uplift.csv on a flat 10 m surface, uniform 1 m/a rain to 15 Myr then orographic rain (wind 2 m/s from south), erosion-only stream power law plus linear hillslope creep. Run through KI tools s5_run/run_badlands.py and s6_output/parse_badlands_output.py; values are from the final tin output (tin.time200.hdf5) unless named initial.
engine_version: badlands 2.3.1 (github.com/badlands-model/badlands, local source commit a6d7b3a), python 3.12.3, numpy 1.26.4, scipy 1.17.1

numeric_checks.name: run_status_completed
numeric_checks.why: KI run tool reports status completed (model finished normally)

numeric_checks.name: model_tnow_line_yr
numeric_checks.why: Badlands' own end-of-run line 'tNow = 50000000 (... seconds)' (model finished normally)

numeric_checks.name: final_time_yr
numeric_checks.why: model reached the XML end time 50 Myr

numeric_checks.name: n_tin_steps
numeric_checks.why: one tin output per 250 kyr display step, 0..50 Myr = 201 files

numeric_checks.name: last_step_number
numeric_checks.why: last output file is tin.time200 (parser orders by number, not name)

numeric_checks.name: n_nodes
numeric_checks.why: TIN node count built from data/nodes.csv at resfactor 1

numeric_checks.name: initial_elev_max_m
numeric_checks.why: starting surface is flat at 10 m

numeric_checks.name: final_elev_min_m
numeric_checks.why: fixed boundary nodes stay at 10 m

numeric_checks.name: final_elev_max_m
numeric_checks.why: highest peak after 50 Myr of uplift + erosion

numeric_checks.name: final_cumdiff_min_m
numeric_checks.why: largest cumulative erosion at one node

numeric_checks.name: final_cumdiff_max_m
numeric_checks.why: no deposition: XML sets sp_law dep=0 (erosion only)

numeric_checks.name: final_total_erosion_m
numeric_checks.why: sum of negative cumdiff over all nodes

numeric_checks.name: final_discharge_max
numeric_checks.why: largest flow discharge at the final step (orographic rain phase)

reference: The workshop ships no reference output files, so the expected values are from our own runs. Three full runs in fresh temp dirs gave bit-identical values. Tolerance: exact (0) for counts and times; for real numbers max(1e-6 * |expected|, 1e-6), i.e. relative 1e-6, with an absolute floor 1e-6 that matters only for final_cumdiff_max_m (expected 0). Non-finite values fail.
notes: Inputs are unmodified official files. No tweak to the XML.
